_source: ADR 0003: the pilot ring is '202-TOC-M4-Max and Cyril's Mac mini'. This file is the machine-readable form of that decision; if it and the ADR disagree, the ADR wins and this file is the bug.
_why_it_matters: Pilot machines are the only Macs whose manifests declare the testing catalog, so this list decides the maximum blast radius of a bad package.

pilots.name: Cyrils-Mac-mini
pilots.resolved_from: known_absent in data/machines.json: no ARD row, probed locally 2026-09-13 (serial RWJ57V9PW4, Mac16,10, macOS 26.6.2)
pilots.munki_name_source: probed on the machine: hostname -s = Cyrils-Mac-mini, 2026-09-13
pilots.open: its Munki identity is currently overridden by ClientIdentifier=t6-test-client, a test artifact (ticket 09). Until that is removed this machine resolves to the t6-test-client manifest, not its own, so it cannot serve as a pilot.
